_what: Reachability of every allosteric / pocket / apo-holo data source, re-checked on 2026-09-02.
_method: curl 8.x, macOS system trust store, -L, 45 s timeout, browser user agent. A TLS failure was retried with -k so that a dead certificate is separated from a dead host. `tls` is 'valid', 'INVALID' (host answers, certificate does not verify), or 'n/a-plain-http'. Every row carries the UTC timestamp of its own probe.
_rule: No fact here is from memory. Every status, byte count and content type is a recorded response. Where a field says 'not checked' or 'UNVERIFIED', it was not established today.
_headline: ASD IS REACHABLE AS A DATA SOURCE TODAY, and was on 2026-08-24 too. The blocker was never the server; it was that the download page builds its file table client-side. The table is a literal array in /ASD/module/download/js/download.js. All 12 release archives were fetched with plain curl. The 2026-08-24 conclusion 'a script cannot fetch ASD today' is FALSIFIED.
